utility_evaluation.REASONING: The required format specifies 4 main items: health_coverage, property_coverage, travel_coverage, additional_services, and total_budget. That makes 5 items total (since total_budget is a separate item in the format). The final coverage plan includes all 5 items. Each is fully specified with details: health_coverage has physical and mental health with providers and costs; property_coverage has home contents and freelancer package with costs and notes; travel_coverage has provider, cost, and notes; additional_services is an empty array; total_budget has monthly/annual costs, savings, retained policy, net increase, breakdown, and deadline compliance. All items are fully covered.
